rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a dive or leap into water.

example.english: That plunge into the water was really quite dangerous.
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 tiu3 seoi2 zan1 hai6 gei2 ging1 him2

rows.note: For falling or rushing into an abstract state such as debt or trouble, this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: After his business failed, he began to plunge into a debt crisis.
example.traditional: 做生意失敗之後，佢開始陷入債務危機。
example.jyutping: zou6 saang1 ji3 sat1 baai6 zi1 hau6 keoi5 hoi1 ci2 haam6 jap6 zaai3 mou6 ngai4 gei1

rows.note: Use this for putting or immersing something in liquid, especially water.

example.english: Before making soup, plunge the dried scallops into water.
example.traditional: 煲湯之前，將乾瑤柱浸喺水入面。
example.jyutping: bou1 tong1 zi1 cin4 zoeng1 gon1 jiu4 cyu5 zam3 hai2 seoi2 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on the act of descending or submerging beneath the water rather than jumping into it.

example.english: The divers began their plunge and slowly descended into the deep sea.
example.traditional: 潛水員開始下潛，慢慢沉入深海。
example.jyutping: cim4 seoi2 jyun4 hoi1 ci2 haa6 cim4 maan6 maan2 cam4 jap6 sam1 hoi2

rows.note: Use this when someone leaps or dives into water rather than merely being immersed in it.

example.english: Seeing someone fall into the sea, he had to plunge into the water to save them.
example.traditional: 見到有人跌落海，佢即刻跳落水救人。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 jau5 jan4 dit3 lok6 hoi2 keoi5 zik1 hak1 tiu3 lok6 seoi2 gau3 jan4
